exposure: Sacral rhomboid diameter (Transverse diameter of Michaelis, TD, and Vertical diameter, VD)
cohort: The study included 200 primigravidas aged 18-40 years with uncomplicated singleton vertex pregnancies between 37-40 weeks gestational age.
finding: Smaller dimensions of the sacral rhomboid and maternal height are independent predictors of contracted pelvis, with the combination of maternal height and transverse diameter of Michaelis providing the best predictive model.
mod_finding: Caesarean section and assisted vaginal delivery were used to define the 'Contracted Pelvis group', which was predicted by the maternal anthropometric parameters.
